title: Number one swung lourdily her midwife’s bag, the other’
html_source:
Stephen is imagining they are mid-wives – we (excluding the first time reader) need to see the big picture;
1 Stephen had enough of the jerk Buck Mulligan and decided not to return to the him or his highness Haines.
2 Mulligan explicitly reminded Stephen of the experience of seeing his mother dying
3 Stephen is grieving
4 Stephen is homeless
6 Stephen in this disjointed state jumps into existential thought when initially casting himself off on Sandymount Strand
7 Having taken himself away from people because of 1-6 and having failed at trying to take himself away from the phenomenological world, he has to deal with the ineluctable sight of women.
8 Immediately he thinks them as bearers, mothers, birthers, life givers, those at the first moment of others.
9 Though “Stephen tends to equate maternal altruism with the gift of blood and vital nutrients”, these unpleasant deranged thoughts due to 1-7 above.
